reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is rememberMeKey derived directly from Math.random() (line 118), which is a known insecure PRNG used for generating remember-me tokens. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes rememberMeKey (derived from Math.random()) concatenated into the HTML response writer print statement (lines 128-133). Although Cookie names are static ('rememberMe'+testCaseNumber), the XSS sink prints the cookie VALUE which is attacker-controllable via Math.random(). Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.
